summary: Master the art of knowledge management with our comprehensive training course. Equip your team with the skills to create and implement effective strategies.
lede: Knowledge management strategy training helps professionals responsible for learning and organizational effectiveness plan how knowledge is managed. The course covers identifying critical knowledge assets, auditing and mapping knowledge flows, and designing a framework for capturing, sharing, and retaining knowledge. Participants also explore approaches to strengthen knowledge-sharing and assess the value of knowledge management initiatives.
audienceIntro: This training is ideal for professionals responsible for learning, knowledge, and organizational effectiveness, including:
audience: HR, Learning and Development, and talent leaders
Public sector knowledge and research teams
modules: KM for Innovation and Continuous Learning
